scientific_intent.scientific_task: Transform independent512-point complex signals forward and apply a normalized inverse.
scientific_intent.mathematical_operation: X[k]=sum_j x[j]*exp(-2πijk/512); inverse uses +sign and divides by512.
scientific_intent.discretization_or_topology: 128 contiguous independent512-point complex sequences,65536 values,1MiB Float64-pair data.
invariants: Forward followed by normalized inverse approximately returns each input.
Forward spectrum is independently verified so an incorrect invertible permutation cannot pass on roundtrip alone.
accuracy_requirements: All262144 Float64 forward and round-trip scalar components, original default-double atol1e-6; independent CPU O(N²)DFT, original radix8 CPU reference and Parseval relative1e-10.
scientific_intent.precision_sensitivity: Float64 complex multiply/add and sin/cos twiddles, repeated normalized-pair drift; Float32 cuFFT historical path is a different precision/mapping scope.
scientific_intent.input_size_regimes: Source select0 equivalent1MiB/batch128;10 in-place pairs pertrial on shared nonconstant dyadic fixture; larger source size selections and Float32 flag unmeasured.
scientific_intent.community_use_case: Generic spectral/signal transform benchmark; source identifies no scientific signal, imaging modality, PDE or physical application.
scientific_intent.uncertainty: Synthetic dimensionless sequences; no application-level spectral accuracy, sampling interpretation or domain-science validation inferred.
